rows.grounds: Compound of pratimā (image, icon) and āśrayā (resorting, refuge, support); feminine nominative singular describing the subject.

items.question: What form of refuge characterizes the one beyond all others in generosity?
premises: A mode of resort or support is being attributed.
That resort is identified as an image.
The attribution qualifies the supremely generous subject.
items.inference: The supremely generous one is characterized by taking refuge in an image.
uncertainties: The precise compound type and syntactic role depend on the broader sentential context.
